PreInvocation.command: command -v workmux >/dev/null 2>&1 && workmux register-agent >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; printf '{}\n'

hooks.command: command -v workmux >/dev/null 2>&1 && workmux set-window-status working >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; printf '{"decision": "allow"}\n'

Stop.command: command -v workmux >/dev/null 2>&1 && workmux set-window-status done >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; printf '{}\n'
